verdict.rationale: Lighthouse handles EB-1A and EB-2 NIW petitions, and its pricing lists "Immigrant Pathway Strategy Planning" as a Plus-tier item, so green-card continuation is within its own service scope. The pathway pages also frame choosing whether a visa should "stand alone or sit beside another option." However, no evidence explicitly documents a strategy for moving from an O-1 to EB-1A or NIW. Missing for 10: an explicit documented O-1-to-green-card sequencing strategy (timing, evidence reuse, dual intent), confirmation that pathway planning is available to individual founders rather than only the Plus workforce tier, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider documents the green-card continuation — EB-1A or EB-2 NIW strategy after the work visa — so the O-1 is a path, not a dead end

citations.quote: Immigrant Pathway Strategy Planning for Workforce — Included (Plus)
We work with you to map your accomplishments to the specific criteria required, building a robust and persuasive case for your application.
At Lighthouse, we guide you through the whole process, ensuring your achievements and their national significance are effectively highlighted.
the most important early decision is whether this pathway should stand alone or sit beside another option.
